$comment: Planning artifact only. Not imported by runtime. Unicode translations are intentional.
scope: Starter inventory of public interface copy and proposed localization controls. English and Serbian source text already coexist in the current application.
reviewPolicy: Serbian Latin and Russian Cyrillic translations require native-language editorial review and in-context layout checks before release.
rules: Translate display labels only; retain route query values, event-category keys, database IDs and API error codes.
Do not translate or overwrite artist names, venue names, official event titles, source captions, extracted evidence or original posters.
English translations may differ from source.text when the current interface text is Serbian.
Preserve interpolation identifiers in every language. Render plain strings through React text nodes, not HTML injection.
Plural drafts require ICU-compatible formatting or equivalent tested Intl.PluralRules branches; never concatenate translated noun fragments.
Format dates, weekdays, times and numbers through locale-aware formatters; do not introduce hardcoded translated month or weekday arrays.
External browser menu captions in installation diagrams must match the illustrated browser language and version; do not blindly replace OS labels with website translations.
remainingInventory: Long installation instructions and browser-specific illustrated menus.
Complete custom auth validation/reset flows, Clerk error-code mapping and all email templates.
Long SEO descriptions, FAQ answers, structured data, social artwork and calendar export text.
Additional map controls, loading skeleton accessibility labels, profile scenes and venue category variants.
Accessibility labels assembled from dynamic event titles, venue names and counts.
All public-facing fallback errors currently returned as raw server or provider messages.
